title: Chapter 69: Joining The Ox Tribe
content:
Chapter 69: Joining The Ox Tribe

As expected, except for the cavalry monitoring nearby, no one paid attention to the alliance's more than 20,000 troops.

The sun was setting, and if no one came to arrange the territory to be stationed, Wu Qing's more than 20,000 troops would have to fight a war with the weirdness first.

Wu Qing learned from Meng that the merchant could buy a fortune array map, which could be opened with the fortune in the fortune beads as energy to protect the army from being stationed in the wild.

The evil god camp also had something similar, which could consume faith energy and protect the army from being stationed in the wild.

Wu Qing then understood why the bear goblins he encountered at the beginning could set up camp in the wild.

Meng had such a map in his hand, but if he wanted to protect more than 20,000 troops from camping in the wild, the amount of fortune consumed was a bit scary. He would never do this unless it was absolutely necessary.

"How to play? Do you want to play big?"

"This is not even a weakened area of lord protection. It will be lively at night. I am not sure I can hold on here until tomorrow morning!"

"If we are unlucky and attract something scary, everyone will have to die here!"

Meng chewed the dried meat he brought with him and asked Wu Qing for his opinion.

Yu Chong and Bai Yan also looked at Wu Qing. They understood that Meng was the boss here on the surface, but in fact, Wu Qing's opinion was the most important.

"I sent the host out for a look. There are several territories nearby, all of which have become military camps. Shall we grab a territory?"

Wu Qing smiled. He was not nervous at all.

"No one arranged it, so of course I have to grab it myself!"

"Tell me the situation first, and I'll see who is more convenient to grab!"

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan surrounded Wu Qing and began to discuss in a low voice.

"The situation of these territories is clear at a glance. Each territory is only stationed with soldiers of one race, which is very easy to distinguish."

"The territory closest to us is stationed with about 5,000 Tengu soldiers."

"The territory closest to us is stationed with the Ox Tribe, which also has about 5,000 soldiers."

"Other territories are also stationed with troops from the Pig Tribe, Rat Tribe, Snake Tribe and Cat Tribe, and the number of soldiers stationed is not much different, all around 5,000."

"Which race's territory do you think we should rob?"

Wu Qing looked at Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan and asked.

The three looked at each other and said almost in unison: "Of course we should rob the Ox Tribe!"

Wu Qing asked in surprise: "Why the Ox Tribe? Shouldn't we choose the weakest Rat Tribe?"

"Because the Ox Tribe is honest and stubborn, it is one of the least popular races in the Tengu Tribe. If we go to them, maybe we can have a place to stay without robbing them."

Yu Chong explained to Wu Qing with a smile.

"So you are bullying the honest people!"

Wu Qing also understood what everyone meant.

No matter how strong or weak other races are, they may be intimidated by the pressure of the Tengu tribe and dare to fight a big battle with the alliance army.

Although everyone acted very tough, it would still be very difficult to end a battle with the troops of the same camp here. It is better not to fight if you can avoid it.

The cattle tribe is different. According to their personality and current situation, Meng and the other three lords should have a way to make the cattle tribe take the initiative to give up some territory, which will save a lot of trouble.

"Then let's go? Let's have a good chat with the cattle people!"

"Let's go! Get the territory as soon as possible, so that we can feel at ease sooner!"

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan went to mobilize the team. The Zerg did not need to be mobilized, so Wu Qing was relatively free.

As for the small troops monitoring around the alliance army, the four did not take them seriously. Both sides were like this, and they were just about to fall out on the spot. What else is there to worry about?

The alliance army started to move again, and the troops responsible for monitoring became nervous and immediately sent people to report.

The Zerg army moved as soon as they said they would, and rushed to the territory where the Ox tribe was stationed with an unstoppable momentum.

The periphery of the alliance army was full of terrifying Zerg puppies. They only obeyed Wu Qing's orders and ignored any reactions from the outside world. The surveillance troops wanted to come over to communicate, but they couldn't do it.

There was a team of cavalry left by the Tengu general at the beginning. They wanted to imitate their general and rushed to the front of the puppies to stop and scold them, but they were directly rushed to the side by the puppies.

The cold blade arm and carapace of the puppy stimulated their nerves, so that they dared not make any other movements except to retreat continuously.

Under the escort of the surveillance troops, more than 20,000 alliance troops rushed directly to the small city where the Ox tribe was stationed.

Most of the Ox tribe troops who heard the movement had already gathered and lined up to guard various places on the city wall.

These Ox tribe people were tall and strong, with a buffalo head on their strong bodies, full of power, especially the thick horns.

Their weapons and equipment were much worse than those of the Bull Tribe infantry of the Tiger Territory. Many of them were shirtless and didn't even have simple leather armor.

"Who are you? Why are you attacking the territory guarded by my Bull Tribe?!"

A particularly tall and strong Bull Tribe member stood up on the low city wall. Wu Qing looked at him and couldn't help but think of the Bull Demon King in the myth.

His voice was deep and rich. He was the loudest person besides Meng.

Meng jumped out of the formation and shouted at the same volume: "We are the reinforcements sent by the alliance formed by the independent territory!"

"I am Meng, the lord of the Tiger Territory!"

"TND! We came all the way here to support, but no one received us!"

"I don't know if we offended the young master of the Tengu tribe!"

"It's getting dark now, and we have nowhere to go!"

"We heard that the territory of the cattle tribe is nearby, so we came here to seek refuge!"

"We hope you will take us in!"

In Wu Qing's opinion, Meng was being more euphemistic. He said he was coming to seek refuge, but in fact he was trying to seize territory.

With the strength of the cattle tribe, they were no match for the alliance army.

This was also considered as using force to suppress others. Generally, less courageous races might be frightened.

But the cattle tribe really took Meng's words seriously!

"It's okay to take you in! But this territory is too small. Part of your army can only be stationed outside the city, which is a bit dangerous at night!"

"Besides, we don't have enough supplies here, so you can only starve!"

The leading cattle tribe member agreed to Meng's request without thinking much.

"Aren't these cattle tribe members afraid of being deceived with their personalities?"

While Meng was communicating with the cattle tribe members, Wu Qing asked Yu Chong beside him softly.

"Although the cattle people are easy to talk to, their stubborn character is also terrible!"

"If anyone cheats them, they will pursue it until the end of time!"

"Ordinary people really don't dare to cheat them!"

Yu Chong explained with a smile.

Wu Qing understood that the races that can survive in this world have their own uniqueness. Without some ability, they can't reproduce in such a cruel world.

The communication between Meng and the cattle people was very smooth. After understanding the nature of the alliance, the cattle leader became very enthusiastic.

The tiger leader is also famous, and the cattle leader has also heard of it.

With Meng's intentional catering, the place where the alliance army is stationed finally has a place to go.
